accepted.description: R1-R8 accepted as the provider-neutral signer baseline.

provider_neutral.description: Baseline expresses security properties, never vendor names.

allows_automatic_supplier_choice.description: No provider/product is ever selected automatically.

supplier_selection.description: Explicit human supplier-selection state. Remains NO_SELECTION until a recorded decision.

requires_external_signer.description: R1: private key never in repo/Runner; signing performed by signer; caller gets signature only.

requires_non_exportable_private_key.description: R1: private key non-exportable at the provider.

requires_purpose_bound_key_identity.description: R2: domain hex0r.tb1.authorization.v1 + purpose tb1-authorization bound to one key_id.

requires_explicit_trust_store.description: R3: explicit public trust store under /etc|/run|/var/run with path/key_id/algorithm/digest binding.

requires_trust_store_digest_binding.description: R3: SHA-256 of committed public material bound to trust-store key_id+algorithm.

requires_provider_observation_attestatio.description: R4: a fresh, evidence-verified OBSERVED attestation is required for any passed signer observation.

requires_signing_enabled_active.description: R4/R6: observed key must be active and enabled for signing; stale/future timestamps fail closed.

requires_auditability.description: R5: signer outputs are attributable; absence of audit record for a signature fails closed.

requires_revocation_rotation_fail_closed.description: R6: revocation invalidates future verification deterministically; rotation is trust-store content + expected hash.

requires_cost_proportional_bring_up.description: R7: reproducible from non-secret descriptor; lab profile must not require a hardware procurement cycle.

requires_evidence_separation.description: R8: signer outputs are evidence inputs; no key material/token/header in sanitized evidence.

candidate_classes.description: Evaluation-only candidate classes. Never auto-selects a winner.

is_custody_proof.description: False for PKCS11 (interface, not custody). True only for an actual custody backend once proven.

capability_evidence.description: Recorded capability evidence references (evidence:// refs + digests). Null when not captured.
